Confidence Score: 5/5

**[Medium impact]** This PR appears safe to merge.

Summary

This PR prevents pending token checks from undoing sign-out. - Sign-out makes earlier session checks return no user. Code and tests were inspected. Tests were not run during this review.

Diagram

 ```mermaid %%{init: {'theme': 'neutral'}}%% flowchart TD A[getUser captures generation] --> B[Wait for token check] B --> C{Generation unchanged?} C -->|No| D[Return user null without changing storage] C -->|Yes| E[Keep existing success or error behavior] F[signOut] --> G[Advance generation] G --> H[Clear stored session] ```
